paper.title_en: Universal Structure of Horizon Formation in Generic Binary Black Hole Mergers
paper.abstract_en: We derive the local structure of the first common apparent horizon in a generic binary-black-hole merger. This event occurs in the fully nonlinear regime, outside the standard regimes of post-Newtonian inspiral theory and perturbations of a stationary black hole, yet it admits a universal description. Without assuming symmetry, we show that the stability operator of the marginally outer trapped surface must lose invertibility at formation. Outermost stability then implies that the vanishing eigenvalue is the principal one, with a strictly positive eigenfunction. Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction yields square-root branch separation with a shared linear drift. Together these terms give a tilted parabola through linear order in time. The common horizon lies on a smooth marginally outer trapped tube tangent to the formation slice, and nearby later slices intersect it in outer and inner branches whose separation scales as $(t-t_*)^{1/2}$. Horizon quantities with a nonzero first response along the zero mode inherit the square-root separation and a shared linear term. We test these predictions in three binary black hole simulations, including an eccentric, precessing, unequal-mass system. In all three, the worldtube geometry and quasilocal scalars follow the predicted scaling. With the next-order term included, free-exponent fits to the surface geometry and quasilocal functionals recover $1/2$ to within half a percent, and diagnostics agree on the formation time within $5\times10^{-5}M$. The correlation between horizon shear and gravitational-wave news suggests that common horizon formation could have a signature in a short segment of the merger waveform.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在完全非线性区域研究双黑洞并合中首次共同视界的普适结构，结合Lyapunov-Schmidt约化与数值模拟验证，理论框架清晰且具有潜在可观测信号，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 一般双黑洞并合中视界形成的普适结构
decision.abstract_zh: 我们推导了一般双黑洞并合中第一个共同表观视界的局部结构。该事件发生在完全非线性区域，超出了后牛顿旋进理论和静止黑洞微扰的标准适用范围，然而它却允许一种普适描述。在不假设对称性的情况下，我们证明边缘外陷获面的稳定性算子在形成时必须丧失可逆性。最外层稳定性进而意味着消失的特征值是主特征值，且具有严格正的特征函数。Lyapunov-Schmidt约化给出具有共享线性漂移的平方根分支分离。这些项共同给出时间线性阶上的倾斜抛物线。共同视界位于一个光滑的边缘外陷获管上，该管与形成切片相切，而附近较晚的切片与其相交于外分支和内分支，其分离按$(t-t_*)^{1/2}$标度。沿零模具有非零一阶响应的视界量继承平方根分离和一个共享线性项。我们在三个双黑洞模拟中检验了这些预言，包括一个偏心、进动、不等质量的系统。在这三个模拟中，世界管几何和准局域标量都遵循预言的标度。在包含下一阶项后，对表面几何和准局域泛函的自由指数拟合在百分之零点五以内恢复出$1/2$，且各诊断在形成时间上一致到$5\times10^{-5}M$以内。视界剪切与引力波新闻之间的相关性表明，共同视界形成可能在并合波形的短片段中留下特征。
